copy.bis: Ang pahilig nga silaw mosangpot sa mas bugnaw nga mga adlaw tungod kay moigo kini sa Earth nga pahilig ug mokatag ang energy sa mas lapad nga lugar.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe living things, such as animals and plants, as biotic factors and light, water, temperature, and soil type, as abiotic factors in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the skill of inferring from observations, not about biotic and abiotic factors in an ecosystem. It does not mention living things, light, water, temperature, or soil type as ecosystem factors, so it is unrelated to this competency.

copy.tl: Ang inferring ay kapag bumubuo ka ng isang pahayag upang ipaliwanag o bigyang-kahulugan ang isang set ng mga obserbasyon, tulad ng pagsasabi na ang kandila ay gawa sa wax dahil sa itsura at pakiramdam nito.
copy.bis: Ang inferring mao kung maghimo ka og usa ka pahayag aron ipasabot o hubaron ang usa ka set sa mga obserbasyon, sama sa pag-ingon nga ang kandila gama sa wax tungod sa dagway ug pagbati niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ingestion is the taking in of food through the mouth
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to explore and describe some ways to use movement, sound, and light to send information between two people
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes ingestion, the first step of digestion. G3-F-8 concerns using movement, sound, and light to send information between people. There is no connection to digestion or ingestion.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ingestion is the taking in of food through the mouth
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and identify sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home and in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes ingestion, a digestive process. G4-F-10 concerns sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy. The card provides no support for that competency.

copy.en: Ingestion is the taking in of food through the mouth, the very first step of the digestive process.
copy.tl: Ang ingestion ay ang pagpasok ng pagkain sa pamamagitan ng bibig, ang pinakaunang hakbang ng proseso ng pagtunaw.
copy.bis: Ang ingestion mao ang pagsulod sa pagkaon pinaagi sa baba, ang labing unang lakang sa proseso sa paghilis.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: An inhibitor like sodium chloride slows down the reaction
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some of the basic characteristics used to describe the weather, such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses chemical reaction rates and inhibitors, which is unrelated to weather characteristics (air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, etc.).

copy.en:
What does an inhibitor do to a chemical reaction?

An inhibitor like sodium chloride slows down the reaction, so the bubbling in hydrogen peroxide becomes weaker and slower.
copy.tl:
Ano ang ginagawa ng inhibitor sa isang chemical reaction?

Pinapabagal ng inhibitor tulad ng sodium chloride ang reaction, kaya humihina at bumabagal ang pagbula sa hydrogen peroxide.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang gibuhat sa inhibitor sa usa ka chemical reaction?

Ang inhibitor sama sa sodium chloride nagpahinay sa reaction, mao nga mohuyang ug mohinay ang pagbula sa hydrogen peroxide.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Sun has three inner layers: the core, the radiative zone, and the convective zone.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain properties of metals in terms of their structure and metallic bonding (sea of electrons model)
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the Sun's internal structure (core, radiative zone, convective zone), which is an astronomy topic. G9-M-10 requires explaining properties of metals in terms of metallic bonding and the sea of electrons model. There is no connection to metals, bonding, or electron models.

copy.en: The Sun has three inner layers: the core, the radiative zone, and the convective zone.
copy.tl: Ang Sun ay may tatlong inner layers: ang core, ang radiative zone, at ang convective zone.
copy.bis: Ang Sun adunay tulo ka inner layers: ang core, ang radiative zone, ug ang convective zone.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Poor conductors, like wood and plastic, gain and lose heat slowly
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that changes in materials can be harmful to living and non-living things in the environment, such as trash disposal, and burning household materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes thermal conductivity (insulation), not harmful changes in materials or environmental harm such as trash disposal or burning household materials.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Poor conductors, like wood and plastic, gain and lose heat slowly
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a physical property (heat conduction), not chemical properties such as being burnt, reacting with other materials, or being degradable/biodegradable.

copy.en: Poor conductors, like wood and plastic, gain and lose heat slowly, so they stay cool longer even when one end is hot.
copy.tl: Ang mga poor conductor, tulad ng kahoy at plastic, ay mabagal makakuha at mawalan ng init, kaya nananatili silang malamig kahit mainit ang isang dulo.
copy.bis: Ang mga poor conductor, sama sa kahoy ug plastic, hinay makakuha ug mawad-an sa init, mao nga magpabilin silang bugnaw bisan init ang usa ka tumoy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Intensity depends on the distance and strength of the earthquake, while magnitude depends on the size of faults.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses earthquake intensity and magnitude, which is Earth science content. G5-L-8 is about plant adaptations to unfavorable conditions (lack of rain or floods). There is no connection to plants, adaptation, or environmental conditions for plants.

copy.en: Intensity depends on the distance and strength of the earthquake, while magnitude depends on the size of faults.
copy.tl: Ang intensity ay nakadepende sa distansya at lakas ng lindol, habang ang magnitude ay nakadepende sa laki ng faults.
copy.bis: Ang intensity nagdepende sa distansya ug kusog sa linog, samtang ang magnitude nagdepende sa gidak-on sa faults.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The intestines are a long tube where the body absorbs nutrients and water from the digested food.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes nutrient absorption in the intestines, which is a digestive system concept. copy.en: The intestines are a long tube where the body absorbs nutrients and water from the digested food.
copy.tl: Ang intestines ay mahabang tubo kung saan sinisipsip ng katawan ang nutrients at tubig mula sa natunaw na pagkain.
copy.bis: Ang intestines usa ka taas nga tubo diin gisuyop sa lawas ang mga nutrients ug tubig gikan sa natunaw nga pagkaon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Many items used at home, school, and in the community are products of scientific inventions
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of pure substances as: a. having fixed chemical composition, examples of which are elements and compounds, and b. that all the atoms of an element have a unique number of protons
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses inventions and their usefulness, with no mention of pure substances, fixed chemical composition, elements, compounds, or atomic protons. It does not support the competency in any way.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: calculate the number of protons, neutrons, and electrons in the atom of several elements, such as aluminum
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about inventions making work easier, not about calculating protons, neutrons, or electrons in atoms. No atomic or subatomic content is present.

copy.en: Many items used at home, school, and in the community are products of scientific inventions that make daily work easier and faster.
copy.tl: Maraming gamit sa bahay, paaralan, at komunidad ay produkto ng mga scientific invention na nagpapadali at nagpapabilis sa pang-araw-araw na gawain.
copy.bis: Daghang gamit sa balay, eskwelahan, ug komunidad mga produkto sa scientific invention nga nagpasayon ug nagpapaspas sa adlaw-adlaw nga buluhaton.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: As pressure on a gas increases, its volume decreases, and as pressure decreases, its volume increases.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify which groups of animals reproduce by giving birth to live young, such as mammals, and which reproduce by laying eggs, such as birds and reptiles
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the inverse relationship between pressure and volume of a gas (Boyle's law), which is a physics/chemistry concept. G5-L-5 is about identifying animal groups that reproduce by giving birth vs laying eggs. The content is entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: As pressure on a gas increases, its volume decreases, and as pressure decreases, its volume increases.
copy.tl: Habang tumataas ang pressure sa gas, bumababa ang volume nito, at habang bumababa ang pressure, tumataas ang volume.
copy.bis: Samtang motaas ang pressure sa gas, mous-os ang volume nito, ug samtang mous-os ang pressure, motaas ang volume.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A doctor checks your thyroid by feeling your neck while you swallow
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a thyroid examination, which belongs to the endocrine system. G4-L-1 specifically requires describing the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems. The thyroid is not one of these systems, and the card provides no information about any of the listed systems.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: sometimes uses an ultrasound or blood test
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the uses of various science equipment and materials used in simple activities, such as a ruler, hand lens, scissors, balloons, modeling clay, and cardboard
assignedReviews.reason: G3-M-3 is about describing uses of simple science equipment and materials used in simple activities (ruler, hand lens, scissors, balloons, modeling clay, cardboard). Ultrasound and blood tests are medical diagnostic tools, not the simple school science equipment listed, and the card does not describe their uses in a way that supports this competency.

copy.en: A doctor checks your thyroid by feeling your neck while you swallow, and sometimes uses an ultrasound or blood test to see if it's making the right amount of hormone.
copy.tl: Sinusuri ng doktor ang thyroid sa pamamagitan ng pagkapa sa leeg habang lumulunok ka, at minsan ginagamit ang ultrasound o blood test para malaman kung tama ang gawang hormone.
copy.bis: Susihon sa doktor ang thyroid pinaagi sa paghikap sa liog samtang motulon ka, ug usahay mogamit og ultrasound o blood test aron mahibaloan kon husto ang hormone nga gihimo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the energy needed to remove an electron from an atom
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a table to show how living things can be classified into groups based on similar characteristics (plants including flowering and non-flowering; animals including mammals, reptiles, insects, birds, fish, amphibians; microorganisms including fungi and bacteria)
assignedReviews.reason: Ionization energy is not a table classifying living things into groups.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the energy needed to remove an electron from an atom
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: Ionization energy is not outer body parts of animals such as head, legs or wings.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It is the energy needed to remove an electron from an atom
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the differences between animals with a backbone (vertebrates) and animals without backbones (invertebrates) by using common local examples of each group
assignedReviews.reason: Ionization energy is unrelated to animals with or without a backbone.

copy.en:
What is ionization energy?

It is the energy needed to remove an electron from an atom, and it generally increases as you move to the right across a period.
copy.tl:
Ano ang ionization energy?

Ito ang energy na kailangan upang tanggalin ang isang electron mula sa atom, at karaniwan itong tumataas habang papunta ka sa kanan ng isang period.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang ionization energy?

Kini ang energy nga gikinahanglan aron tangtangon ang usa ka electron gikan sa atom, ug kasagaran kini motaas samtang mopaingon ka sa tuo sa usa ka period.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The element iridium was found in ocean sedimentary layers in Denmark, Italy, and New Zealand at levels much higher than Earth's crust, matching asteroid levels.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: relate the location and distribution of active volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, and major mountain belts to the distribution of oceanic crust and continental crust
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses an iridium anomaly as evidence of an asteroid impact, not the location/distribution of volcanoes, earthquake epicenters, or mountain belts relative to oceanic and continental crust. It does not support G8-E-5.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The element iridium was found in ocean sedimentary layers in Denmark, Italy, and New Zealand at levels much higher than Earth's crust, matching asteroid levels.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify how oceanic crust and continental crust is associated with the Earth's lithospheric plates
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions Earth's crust and ocean sedimentary layers but does not address how oceanic crust and continental crust are associated with lithospheric plates. It is unrelated to the competency's intended subject.

copy.en: The element iridium was found in ocean sedimentary layers in Denmark, Italy, and New Zealand at levels much higher than Earth's crust, matching asteroid levels.
copy.tl: Ang elementong iridium ay natagpuan sa mga sedimentary layer ng karagatan sa Denmark, Italy, at New Zealand sa antas na mas mataas kaysa crust ng Earth, na tumutugma sa antas ng asteroid.
copy.bis: Ang elementong iridium nakit-an sa mga sedimentary layer sa kadagatan sa Denmark, Italy, ug New Zealand sa lebel nga mas taas kaysa crust sa Earth, nga motakdo sa lebel sa asteroid.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ferrous sulfate contains iron, an element that is the main component of the supplement and helps make healthy blood for the developing baby.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses iron as a nutrient in a supplement for blood health. It does not address bond formation or breaking, chemical change, or formation of a new substance, which are the core of G9-M-2.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ferrous sulfate contains iron, an element that is the main component of the supplement and helps make healthy blood for the developing baby.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain why physical changes are reversible, and chemical changes are irreversible
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about iron supplementation and blood health, not about physical changes being reversible or chemical changes being irreversible. It provides no instructional support for G6-M-3.

copy.en:
Why do pregnant women often take ferrous sulfate supplements?

Ferrous sulfate contains iron, an element that is the main component of the supplement and helps make healthy blood for the developing baby.
copy.tl:
Bakit madalas umiinom ng ferrous sulfate supplements ang mga buntis?

Ang ferrous sulfate ay naglalaman ng iron, isang element na pangunahing sangkap ng supplement at tumutulong sa paggawa ng malusog na dugo para sa lumalaking sanggol.
copy.bis:
Ngano ang mga mabdos sagad moinom og ferrous sulfate supplements?

Ang ferrous sulfate adunay iron, usa ka element nga pangunang sangkap sa supplement ug makatabang sa paghimo og himsog nga dugo alang sa nagtubo nga bata.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Isotopes are forms of a chemical element with specific properties that scientists use to determine the absolute age of rocks and other materials.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of how objects can affect other objects even when they are not in contact with each other, such as magnets attracting other objects, light from the sun, and loud noises hurting our ears
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains isotopic dating of rocks, which is unrelated to the competency about non-contact forces (magnets, sunlight, loud noises). No instructional support for G4-F-8.

copy.en: Isotopes are forms of a chemical element with specific properties that scientists use to determine the absolute age of rocks and other materials.
copy.tl: Ang isotopes ay mga anyo ng isang chemical element na may tiyak na properties na ginagamit ng mga scientist para malaman ang eksaktong edad ng mga bato at iba pang materials.
copy.bis: Ang isotopes kay mga porma sa usa ka chemical element nga adunay piho nga mga properties nga gigamit sa mga scientist aron mahibaloan ang eksaktong edad sa mga bato ug uban pang materials.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Jackfruit seeds can be cooked and eaten
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the edibility of jackfruit seeds, which is unrelated to observing the root and shoot system in plants or describing their importance. No instructional support for the competency.

copy.en: Jackfruit seeds can be cooked and eaten — they taste a bit like boiled cassava or banana!
copy.tl: Ang buto ng langka ay puwedeng lutuin at kainin — halos kasinlasa ng nilagang kamoteng-kahoy o saba!
copy.bis: Ang liso sa nangka mahimong lutoon ug kaonon — lami nga morag linat-ang balanghoy o saging!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Jackfruit is one of the largest fruits that grows on a tree
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that jackfruit is a large tree fruit. It does not address the outer parts of plants (leaves, roots, stems) or their role in obtaining water and nutrients, which is the focus of G3-L-5.

copy.en:
What's one of the biggest fruits on a tree?

Jackfruit is one of the largest fruits that grows on a tree — a single fruit can weigh as much as a school child!
copy.tl:
Ano ang isa sa pinakamalaking prutas sa puno?

Ang langka ay isa sa pinakamalaking prutas na tumutubo sa puno — ang isang bunga nito ay maaaring kasimbigat ng isang batang paaralan!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang usa sa pinakadako nga prutas sa kahoy?

Ang nangka usa sa pinakadako nga prutas nga motubo sa kahoy — ang usa ka bunga niini mahimong sama kabug-at sa usa ka bata nga eskwela!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ripe jackfruit is sweet
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes in properties of materials when exposed to certain changes in temperature, such as changes when wood or coal are burned
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses ripeness and cooking of jackfruit, not changes in material properties due to temperature. It does not support the competency about temperature-induced changes like burning wood or coal.

copy.en: Ripe jackfruit is sweet and eaten as fruit, but unripe jackfruit isn't sweet at all — so it gets cooked into dishes like jackfruit in coconut milk instead!
copy.tl: Ang hinog na langka ay matamis at kinakain bilang prutas, pero ang hilaw na langka ay hindi matamis, kaya iniluluto itong ulam gaya ng ginataang langka!
copy.bis: Ang hinog nga nangka tam-is ug ginakaon isip prutas, apan ang hilaw nga nangka dili tam-is, busa ginaluto kini isip sud-an sama sa ginataang nangka!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Juan Salcedo, Jr. was a Filipino National Scientist
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a Filipino National Scientist and his work in nutrition and public health. It does not address the characteristics of living things (grow, respond, reproduce) at all.

copy.en: Juan Salcedo, Jr. was a Filipino National Scientist who worked in nutrition and public health, helping communities stay healthy through better food.
copy.tl: Si Juan Salcedo, Jr. ay isang Pambansang Scientist ng Pilipinas na nagtrabaho sa nutrition at public health, tumutulong sa mga komunidad na manatiling malusog sa pamamagitan ng mas mabuting pagkain.
copy.bis: Si Juan Salcedo, Jr. usa ka Pambansang Scientist sa Pilipinas nga nagtrabaho sa nutrition ug public health, nagtabang sa mga komunidad nga magpabiling himsog pinaagi sa mas maayong pagkaon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Jupiter orbits the Sun at about 774 million kilometers away
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify and appropriately use units in simple science activities, such as milligrams (mg), grams (g), kilograms (kg), and degrees centigrade (C)
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about identifying and using units in simple science activities, specifically mass (mg, g, kg) and temperature (°C). The card only mentions a distance in kilometers for Jupiter, which is not one of the listed units and does not support the stated skill.

copy.en: Jupiter orbits the Sun at about 774 million kilometers away, making it the fifth planet from the Sun.
copy.tl: Umiikot ang Jupiter sa layong 774 million kilometers mula sa Araw, kaya ito ang ikalimang planeta mula sa Araw.
copy.bis: Ang Jupiter nagtuyok sa gilay-on nga 774 million kilometers sa Adlaw, mao nga kini ang ikalimang planeta sa Adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Your body keeps its temperature steady through thermoregulation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes human thermoregulation (skin, blood vessels, brain), which has no relation to the solar system, celestial objects, or their composition. The assigned competency is entirely unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: Your body keeps its temperature steady through thermoregulation, where your skin, blood vessels, and brain work together to cool you down or warm you up.
copy.tl: Pinapanatili ng katawan mo ang steady na temperatura sa pamamagitan ng thermoregulation, kung saan nagtutulungan ang balat, mga blood vessel, at utak para palamigin o painitin ka.
copy.bis: Gipadayon sa imong lawas ang steady nga temperatura pinaagi sa thermoregulation, diin ang panit, mga blood vessel, ug utok magtinabangay aron pabugnawan o painiton ka.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In a mixture, each substance keeps its own chemical identity
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the factors affecting the rates of chemical reactions as applied in food preservation and materials production, control of fire, pollution, and corrosion
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains that substances in a mixture retain their chemical identity, which is a concept about mixtures versus compounds. It does not address factors affecting the rates of chemical reactions, nor applications to food preservation, materials production, fire control, pollution, or corrosion. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: In a mixture, each substance keeps its own chemical identity, meaning it does not change into a new substance.
copy.tl: Sa isang mixture, nananatili ng bawat substance ang sarili nitong chemical identity, ibig sabihin hindi ito nagbabago bilang bagong substance.
copy.bis: Sa usa ka mixture, ang matag substance nagpabilin sa kaugalingon nga chemical identity, nagpasabot nga dili kini mausab ngadto sa bag-ong substance.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Kerosene is an organic compound used as fuel for lamps and stoves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes kerosene as a fuel and flammable organic compound. It has no relation to specialized structures in plants (rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, aerial roots).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Kerosene is an organic compound used as fuel for lamps and stoves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about kerosene fuel, not about plant adaptations to unfavorable conditions such as lack of rain or floods.

copy.en: Kerosene is an organic compound used as fuel for lamps and stoves, and it is also highly flammable, so it must be handled with care.
copy.tl: Ang kerosene ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang fuel ng mga lampara at kalan, at ito rin ay highly flammable, kaya dapat itong ingatan sa paggamit.
copy.bis: Ang kerosene usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip fuel sa mga lampara ug kalan, ug kini usab highly flammable, busa kinahanglan kini nga ampingan sa paggamit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Natural indicators come from plants, synthetic indicators are made in laboratories, and olfactory indicators change smell instead of color
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe the possible effects of human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and introduction of invasive species, on living things in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: Lab and smell indicators are chemistry, not effects of deforestation, pollution, or invasive species.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Natural indicators come from plants, synthetic indicators are made in laboratories
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not living things interacting through competition or predation.

copy.en:
Are there different kinds of indicators?

Yes! Natural indicators come from plants, synthetic indicators are made in laboratories, and olfactory indicators change smell instead of color.
copy.tl:
May iba't ibang uri ba ng indicator?

Oo! Ang natural indicators ay galing sa halaman, ang synthetic indicators ay gawa sa laboratoryo, at ang olfactory indicators ay nagbabago ng amoy imbes na kulay.
copy.bis:
Aduna bay lain-laing klase sa indicator?

Oo! Ang natural indicators naggikan sa tanom, ang synthetic indicators gihimo sa laboratoryo, ug ang olfactory indicators mag-usab sa baho imbes nga kolor.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Kinetic energy is calculated using KE=1/2mv^2
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the kinetic energy formula, a physics concept. G6-M-4 is about uniform and non-uniform mixtures (solutions and suspensions). There is no connection to mixtures or separation techniques.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Kinetic energy is calculated using KE=1/2mv^2

copy.tl: Para mailarawan nang buo ang isang image, kailangan mong sabihin ang lokasyon, orientation, type, at size nito, na madalas tandaan sa mga letrang L-O-T-S.
copy.bis: Aron mahulagway sa hingpit ang usa ka image, kinahanglan nimong isulti ang lokasyon, orientation, type, ug size niini, nga sagad hinumdoman sa mga letra nga L-O-T-S.

copy.bis: Ang land development, o ang pag-ilis sa yuta aron mahimong residential area ug mga bilding, makaguba sa pinuy-anan sa mga organismo ug makapahinabo sa extinction.

copy.tl: Ang mga kalupaan ay nagbibigay ng friction na nagpapabagal sa hangin ng bagyo, na tumutulong magpahina sa bagyo habang pumapasok sa loob ng lupa.
copy.bis: Ang mga kayutaan maghatag ug friction nga nagpahinay sa hangin sa bagyo, nga makatabang sa pagpaluya sa bagyo samtang mosulod sa yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The flesh of lanzones is sweet, but the seed hidden inside tastes bitter.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the taste of a lanzones seed, which is unrelated to observing outer plant parts (leaves, roots, stems) or their role in water and nutrient uptake from the soil.

copy.en: The flesh of lanzones is sweet, but the seed hidden inside tastes bitter.
copy.tl: Matamis ang laman ng lanzones, pero mapait naman ang buto sa loob nito.
copy.bis: Tam-is ang unod sa lanzones, apan mapait ang liso sa sulod niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The large intestine includes the cecum
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the relative wavelengths and frequencies of different types of electromagnetic waves, including radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultra-violet, x-rays, and gamma radiation

copy.en: The large intestine includes the cecum, ascending colon, transverse colon, descending colon, and sigmoid colon, and it absorbs water from waste.
copy.tl: Ang large intestine ay binubuo ng cecum, ascending colon, transverse colon, descending colon, at sigmoid colon, at sinisipsip nito ang tubig mula sa dumi.
copy.bis: Ang large intestine naglakip sa cecum, ascending colon, transverse colon, descending colon, ug sigmoid colon, ug mosuyop kini sa tubig gikan sa hugaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Lasers produce highly directional, intensified light that doctors use in surgery to make precise cuts with less bleeding.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: create a scale drawing to represent relative thicknesses of the layers of Earth's interior, including the crust, lithosphere, asthenosphere, mantle, outer core, and inner core
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses laser surgery, which is unrelated to creating a scale drawing of Earth's interior layers. No content supports the competency.

copy.en: Lasers produce highly directional, intensified light that doctors use in surgery to make precise cuts with less bleeding.
copy.tl: Ang laser ay gumagawa ng napaka-direktang at pinalakas na liwanag na ginagamit ng mga doktor sa operasyon para sa tiyak na paghiwa na may kaunting pagdurugo.
copy.bis: Ang laser naghimo ug highly directional ug gipalig-on nga kahayag nga gigamit sa mga doktor sa operasyon para sa saktong paghiwa nga adunay gamay nga pagdugo.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses latitude and temperature, which is a geography/climate concept. G6-F-2 requires demonstrating advantages and limitations of simple machines such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys. The card provides no support for this competency.

copy.en: As latitude increases away from the equator, the angle of the sun's rays decreases, so the air temperature becomes cooler.
copy.tl: Habang tumataas ang latitude palayo sa equator, bumababa ang anggulo ng sinag ng araw, kaya mas lumalamig ang temperatura ng hangin.
copy.bis: Samtang motaas ang latitude palayo sa equator, mous-os ang anggulo sa silaw sa adlaw, mao nga mas mobugnaw ang temperatura sa hangin.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: design and construct a simple electrical circuit to identify what materials will conduct electricity and use it to identify materials from the environment that will and will not conduct electricity

copy.en: Lava flow is a stream of molten rock and other fragmented materials emitted by an erupting volcano, with temperatures between 800 and 1,200 degrees Celsius.
copy.tl: Ang lava flow ay mga daloy ng molten rock at iba pang pira-pirasong materyales na ibinubuga ng sumasabog na bulkan, na may temperaturang nasa pagitan ng 800 hanggang 1,200 degrees Celsius.
copy.bis: Ang lava flow kay mga agos sa molten rock ug uban pang mga tipik nga materyales nga gipagawas sa mobuto nga bulkan, nga adunay temperatura tali sa 800 hangtod 1,200 degrees Celsius.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that forces cause objects to accelerate, and that acceleration of an object is its rate of change of velocity
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about DNA replication, not about forces causing acceleration or rate of change of velocity. It does not support the physics competency G8-F-1 in any way.

copy.en: During replication, the leading strand is built continuously in the same direction as the unwinding fork, using just one primer.
copy.tl: Sa panahon ng replication, ang leading strand ay tuloy-tuloy na nabubuo sa parehong direksyon ng unwinding fork, gamit ang isang primer lamang.
copy.bis: Sa panahon sa replication, ang leading strand padayon nga gihimo sa samang direksyon sa unwinding fork, gamit ang usa lang ka primer.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about adding flavorings to leche flan to improve taste and aroma. It does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, suspensions, or any mixture-related concept. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Add a little vanilla or calamansi zest to leche flan! It hides the eggy smell and gives it a much nicer flavor and aroma.
copy.tl: Lagyan ng kaunting vanilla o balat ng kalamansi ang leche flan! Pinapatay nito ang malansang amoy ng itlog at nagbibigay ng mas masarap na lasa at bango.
copy.bis: Dugangi og gamay nga vanilla o panit sa kalamansi ang leche flan! Mawala ang baho sa itlog ug makabaton kini og mas lami nga lasa ug humot.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: For electron flow, which moves from negative to positive, use your left hand the same way
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make a list or draw up a table with examples of animals and plants in a particular habitat, such as a garden, rice field, seashore, and mangrove swamp
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the left-hand rule for electron flow in electromagnetism, which is unrelated to making a list or table of animals and plants in a habitat. The assigned living-things competency has no instructional connection to this physics content.

copy.en: For electron flow, which moves from negative to positive, use your left hand the same way: thumb for current, fingers for magnetic field, and palm for the magnetic force.
copy.tl: Para sa electron flow, na gumagalaw mula negative papuntang positive, gamitin ang iyong kaliwang kamay sa parehong paraan: hinlalaki para sa current, mga daliri para sa magnetic field, at palad para sa magnetic force.
copy.bis: Alang sa electron flow, nga molihok gikan sa negative paingon sa positive, gamita ang imong wala nga kamot sa samang paagi: kumagko alang sa current, mga tudlo alang sa magnetic field, ug palad alang sa magnetic force.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the female reproductive system as ovaries, uterus, and vagina and those of the male reproductive system as the prostate, testis, and penis and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses nitrogen-fixing bacteria and leguminous root nodules, which has no connection to identifying or describing the parts of the female and male reproductive systems as required by G5-L-3.

copy.tl: Ang ilang nitrogen-fixing bacteria ay malayang naninirahan sa lupa, habang ang iba naman ay matatagpuan sa mga root nodules ng leguminous plants.
copy.bis: Ang uban nga nitrogen-fixing bacteria gawasnon nga nagpuyo sa yuta, samtang ang uban makita sa mga root nodules sa leguminous plants.

copy.bis: Ayaw tugoti nga motugpa ang objective lens sa slide, kay ang lens makagaray sa baso o makadaot sa specimen.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses reducing CFC spray use to protect the atmosphere, which is an environmental conservation topic. It provides no information about distance, displacement, or reference points, so it does not support the competency.

copy.tl: Ang pagbabawas sa paggamit ng CFC sprays ay isang konserbasyon na nagpoprotekta sa atmosphere mula sa mga mapanganib na kemikal.
copy.bis: Ang pagpakunhod sa paggamit sa CFC sprays usa ka konserbasyon nga nagprotektar sa atmosphere batok sa makadaot nga mga kemikal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Each level of biological organization is interconnected

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses biological organization levels, not changes in material properties due to temperature. No support for this matter competency.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about biological organization, not chemical properties of materials such as burning, reactivity, or biodegradability. Unrelated to the competency.

copy.tl: Ang bawat level ng biological organization ay magkakaugnay, kaya ang pagbabago sa isang level, tulad ng nasirang cells, ay maaaring makaapekto sa tissues, organs, at maging sa buong organism.
copy.bis: Ang matag level sa biological organization magkadugtong, busa ang pagbag-o sa usa ka level, sama sa nadaot nga cells, makaapekto sa tissues, organs, ug bisan sa tibuok organism.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A surge of LH, or luteinizing hormone, causes ovulation

copy.bis: Ang pagsaka sa LH, o luteinizing hormone, maoy hinungdan sa ovulation, ang higayon nga mogawas ang hamtong nga itlog gikan sa follicle niini sa ovary.

copy.en:
Where can you find living things that survive in boiling hot springs?

In the domain Archaea! These microscopic organisms have no nucleus and can live in extreme places like very salty water or volcanic heat.
copy.tl:
Saan makakakita ng mga bagay na may buhay na nabubuhay sa kumukulong mainit na bukal?

Sa domain na Archaea! Ang mga microscopic organismong ito ay walang nucleus at kayang mabuhay sa matitinding lugar tulad ng napakaalat na tubig o init ng bulkan.
copy.bis:
Asa makakita og mga buhing butang nga mabuhi sa nagbukal nga init nga tubod?

Sa domain nga Archaea! Kining mga microscopic nga organismo walay nucleus ug makapuyo sa grabeng mga lugar sama sa parat kaayo nga tubig o kainit sa bulkan.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: carry out guided investigations to identify the properties of magnets, including how they affect other magnets and objects made of different materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the impact of everyday inventions (soap, pens, ovens) on daily life. It contains no content about magnets, their properties, or investigations involving magnets, which is the sole focus of G4-F-7.

What would life be like if soap, pens, and ovens were never invented?

Life would be much harder and slower, because we would have to do everything by hand without these helpful tools!
copy.tl:
Ano kaya ang buhay kung hindi naimbento ang sabon, panulat, at oven?

Mas mahirap at mas mabagal ang buhay, dahil kailangan nating gawin ang lahat gamit ang kamay nang walang mga makatutulong na kasangkapan!
copy.bis:
Unsa kaha ang kinabuhi kon wala pa maimbento ang sabon, pen, ug oven?

Mas lisud ug mas hinay ang kinabuhi, tungod kay kinahanglan nato nga buhaton ang tanan gamit ang kamot nga walay mga makatabang nga galamiton!

copy.tl: Sa isang experiment tungkol sa paglaki ng halaman, ang dami ng liwanag o ang uri ng lupa ay maaaring maging independent variable na sadya mong binabago.
copy.bis: Sa usa ka eksperimento sa pagtubo sa tanom, ang gidaghanon sa kahayag o ang klase sa yuta mahimong independent variable nga imong tuyo nga usbon.

assignedReviews.reason: The card explains that light travels from a source to objects so we can see them. This is a physics/light concept and has no connection to biodiversity, ecosystem stability, or difficult conditions such as food shortages, disease, or climate change.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Light travels from a source
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe using labeled diagrams the biotic and abiotic features of tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes light traveling from a source, which is unrelated to describing biotic and abiotic features of tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, or coral reefs using labeled diagrams.

copy.en: Light travels from a source, like a flashlight, to objects so we can see them.
copy.tl: Ang liwanag ay nagmumula sa isang source, tulad ng flashlight, papunta sa mga bagay upang makita natin ang mga ito.
copy.bis: Ang kahayag mobiyahe gikan sa usa ka source, sama sa flashlight, padulong sa mga butang aron makita nato kini.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses light reflection and refraction (optics), not plant organs or the transport system in plants. It provides no instructional support for G8-L-3.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about light behavior, not the outer parts of plants or their roles in water/nutrient uptake. It is unrelated to G3-L-5.

copy.en: When light enters a new medium obliquely, part of it reflects and part of it refracts, so the intensity of the transmitted light decreases.
copy.tl: Kapag pahilis na pumasok ang liwanag sa bagong medium, bahagi nito ay nagre-reflect at bahagi ay nagre-refract, kaya nababawasan ang intensity ng liwanag na dumadaan.
copy.bis: Kon pahilis nga mosulod ang kahayag sa bag-ong medium, ang uban nagre-reflect ug ang uban nagre-refract, mao nga mokunhod ang intensity sa kahayag nga moagi.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Light energy travels through space in all directions in the form of waves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about light energy and wave propagation, which has no connection to identifying the role of solute and solvent in a solution.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes light spreading as waves, not uniform or non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions.

copy.en: Light energy travels through space in all directions in the form of waves, spreading out from its source like ripples on a pond.
copy.tl: Ang light energy ay naglalakbay sa space sa lahat ng direksyon bilang waves, kumakalat mula sa pinagmulan nito tulad ng mga alon sa lawa.
copy.bis: Ang light energy mobiyahe sa space sa tanang direksyon isip waves, mokatap gikan sa gigikanan sama sa mga balod sa lanaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A line graph is a special science tool that shows trends and changes over a continuous interval
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that some organisms consist of a single cell (unicellular) like in bacteria and some consist of many cells (multicellular) like in a human

Why does a doctor press your neck during a checkup?

A doctor feels your neck, armpits, or groin to check if your lymph nodes are swollen, which helps tell if your body has an infection.
copy.tl:
Bakit kinakapa ng doktor ang leeg mo sa checkup?

Kinakapa ng doktor ang leeg, kilikili, o singit para tingnan kung namamaga ang lymph node, para malaman kung may impeksyon ang katawan.
copy.bis:
Ngano gikapkap sa doktor ang imong liog sa checkup?

Gikapkap sa doktor ang imong liog, ilok, o singit aron tan-awon kon manghupong ang lymph node, aron mahibaloan kon naay impeksyon ang lawas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: most swollen lymph nodes are just from a common infection like a cold
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory

copy.en:
Is every neck lump cancer?

No — most swollen lymph nodes are just from a common infection like a cold, and they heal after. But see a doctor if you're worried.
copy.tl:
Kanser ba ang bawat bukol sa leeg?

Hindi — kadalasan, ang namamagang lymph node ay dahil lang sa karaniwang impeksyon tulad ng sipon, at gumagaling ito pagkatapos. Pero magpasuri pa rin sa doktor kung nag-aalala.
copy.bis:
Kanser ba ang matag bukol sa liog?

Dili — kasagaran, ang manghubag nga lymph node tungod lang sa ordinaryong impeksyon sama sa sip-on, ug maayo ra kini human niini. Apan magpatan-aw gihapon sa doktor kon mabalaka.

Ang conclusion! Ito ang huling desisyon o paghuhusga na ginagawa matapos tingnan ang lahat ng nakalap na datos.
